g.text: Image acquisition; no experimental trace or image generated

Output state: Image the cross-section of an 8.2 nm iodide film
Source scope: Figure 1c is the cross-section SEM of 8.2 nm NCs with iodide ligands. Its scale bar is 500 nm, not
an extracted numerical film thickness. FEI Nova 200 NanoLab is listed in Methods.
